quote: Streets, other than truck routes, shall not be used as through routes from one truck route to another unless pick-up, delivery or essential use is required enroute.

activation.condition: a truck uses a street other than a truck route as a through route from one truck route to another

obligation.description: use a non-truck street as a through route between truck routes
obligation.source_clause: Streets, other than truck routes, shall not be used as through routes from one truck route to another

exceptions.trigger: pick-up, delivery or essential use is required enroute
exceptions.effect: the stated through-route prohibition has an exception
exceptions.source_clause: unless pick-up, delivery or essential use is required enroute.

timing.description: complete journey between the entry and exit truck routes; review required enroute purpose independently

judgment_calls_needed.note: Purpose necessity and essential use remain an unresolved source-grounded judgment; a stop alone does not establish it.

parameter_refs.name: enroute_purpose
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: independently reviewed none, pickup, delivery or essential purpose during the intervening street
